phase: P1 symmetry-breaking development iteration 3: final large-neighborhood test (destroy-eight / exact-repair-nine)
question: Does enlarging the destroy/exact-repair neighbourhood from four to eight removed points (nine exact additions, 200000 nodes per attempt) let the search leave the rigid neighbourhood of a from-scratch P0 58, reaching either a valid 59 or a one-violation 59-point working state?
hypothesis: In the preregistered iteration-3 smoke (breaker seeds 1200..1207, 200000 fallback swaps per seed, destroy size 8, repair target 9 additions, 200000 exact-repair nodes per attempt, one attempt at startup and one after each 20000-swap stall restart, 8 workers, the same P0 parent bb6b15b0-c0b9-426f-a67d-464cdce1a551 and round-robin source policy), the infrastructure gate passes under the unchanged rules, with --destroy-size an explicit, validated and artifacted argument. The search hypothesis is that at least one trial reaches a persisted, dual- and upstream-verified 59 (development record candidate) or a working state with fewer than two violations (operator progress). It is rejected if no 59 is found and the minimum working violations remains 2.
primary_metric: infrastructure gate status of the eight-trial smoke and the search-progress class (record candidate / operator progress / no progress); supporting metrics are verified 59 count, best valid score, minimum working violations per trial (recounted by the controller), exact-repair attempts, exhausted attempts, nodes, zero-cost pool sizes and deepest repair depth, the origin of each trial's best state (exact repair or swap), failure classes, oracle disagreements, wall and CPU seconds, and cost
baseline: Immutable P0 baseline: Git commit 2914794, run bb6b15b0-c0b9-426f-a67d-464cdce1a551 (10 of 64 from-scratch trials reached a dual-verified 58 with solver/solver.c). P1 inputs are only that run's verified 58-point child artifacts, re-verified by both oracles before every breaker invocation. The public 58-point certificate is never read by the breaker or the controller.
trial_definition: One trial is one seeded symmetry-breaker invocation on one verified P0 candidate in its own subprocess. Inner swaps are counted separately and are not trials.
cost_model: The P1 development smoke runs only on the local machine with no provider calls, so its marginal cost is 0.0 USD. The 20 USD figure is the ceiling for the whole experiment; none of it is authorized in this tranche.
stop_condition: Run the eight-seed iteration-3 smoke once; do not tune after seeing results. Iteration 3 is the stopping boundary for the destroy/repair operator family: if the minimum working violations remains 2 and no 59 is verified, the family is closed as stopped, no further budget or parameter change is proposed for it, and no confirmatory seed is spent on it. A one-violation state would only justify a separately preregistered follow-up. Stop before the smoke if the breaker's incremental state disagrees with brute force; stop and preserve the artifact on any oracle disagreement. Seeds 64..127 stay untouched. record_claim stays false even if a 59 is verified. Both earlier P1 runs and every earlier artifact stay byte-for-byte unchanged. No sponsor integration or Modal run is part of this tranche.
dual_verification_gate: A candidate is accepted only when the per-apex distance oracle (src/tripathy_experiment/no_isosceles.py) and the perpendicular-bisector oracle (src/tripathy_experiment/perpendicular_bisector_oracle.py) both accept it in the controller. Any disagreement is an infrastructure failure that is written to an artifact and makes the run exit nonzero. In P1 a 59 additionally counts only after a fresh process re-reads the persisted child artifact and both oracles plus the pinned upstream verify_construction accept it.

p0.question: Can a deterministic compiled local search that starts from an empty 32 x 32 grid reproduce the public 58-point no-isosceles result for AlphaEvolve Problem 59 under a fixed, declared iteration budget, with every result accepted only by two structurally independent exact oracles?
p0.hypothesis: At a fixed budget of 1000000 ruin/repair iterations per trial, at least one of the 64 from-scratch trials with seeds 0..63 of the mirror-symmetric baseline solver (solver/solver.c) reaches a dual-verified 58-point set, with zero oracle disagreements. The hypothesis is rejected if 0 of 64 trials reach 58.
p0.primary_metric: number of the 64 trials whose dual-verified cardinality reaches 58, reported with a 95% exact binomial interval; secondary metrics are best dual-verified cardinality, score distribution, wall and CPU seconds per trial, failure classes, and oracle disagreement count
p0.baseline: From-scratch deterministic C99 solver (solver/solver.c), symmetric under y -> 31-y, one seeded invocation per trial. The public 58-point certificate from google-deepmind/alphaevolve_repository_of_problems issue 10 is the external target only and is never used as solver initialization.
p0.trial_definition: One trial is one from-scratch seeded solver invocation in its own subprocess. Inner ruin/repair iterations are counted separately and are not trials.
p0.cost_model: P0 runs only on the local machine with no provider calls, so its marginal cost is 0.0 USD. The 20 USD figure is the ceiling for the whole experiment; none of it is authorized in P0.
p0.stop_condition: P0 stops after the single 64-trial gate. If the solver fails deterministic replay or the two oracles disagree, stop before the gate and preserve the failing fixture. If 0 of 64 trials reach 58, record a failed reproduction gate and stop without tuning on seeds 0..63. If at least one trial reaches 58, record a passed gate and stop; no 59-point record search is part of P0. If the gate would exceed 15 minutes of wall-clock time, lower the iteration budget and label the run a screening gate.

reproducibility.iteration_budget_calibration: Chosen on off-gate seeds 1000..1015 only: about 13 seconds per trial with 8 workers on an Apple M5 Max. Wall time is measured per trial as a secondary quantity.
